steps.text: In Kakariko Village, lift the small rock just inside the Graveyard entrance and catch the bugs underneath in an empty bottle.
steps.detail: You need them for a soft soil patch outside Dodongo's Cavern; there are no bugs up on the mountain. Scoop them with the bottle as soon as they scurry out.

steps.text: Climb to the top of Kakariko Village and show Zelda's Letter to the guard at the Death Mountain gate. He opens it for you.
steps.detail: Sit through his speech; the mask he mentions is a later side quest. Equip the Hylian Shield before going up. If you never took the free one from the Graveyard, the Bazaar in the Market now sells it for 60 Rupees.

steps.text: Head up Death Mountain Trail past the Red Tektites and talk to the Goron standing next to the huge boulder that seals Dodongo's Cavern.
steps.detail: Z-target a Tektite, wait for it to jump at you and press B without moving the stick to slash it out of the air. Deku Nuts also stun them. The Goron explains Ganondorf sealed the cavern.

steps.text: Continue up the trail into the wide area with the flag, keep clear of the rolling Goron, and enter the bannered doorway of Goron City.
steps.detail: The rolling Goron circles near the flag; if he hits you, you get knocked off the ledge and have to climb back up.

steps.text: Drop down tier by tier to the bottom floor of Goron City and stand on the carpet in front of the big closed door.
steps.detail: Jumping straight down from the entrance tier is the fastest way. The Goron by the door hints at the solution.

steps.text: Play Zelda's Lullaby on the carpet to open Darunia's door.
Light a Deku Stick on a torch inside Darunia's chamber and light every unlit torch around the bottom floor until the giant urn in the center of the city starts spinning.
steps.detail: The stick burns out after a while; light a fresh one at the chamber torches if needed. The spinning urn is used for a Piece of Heart shortly.

steps.text: With a lit Deku Stick, follow the right wall from Darunia's door up the steps to the corridor blocked by boulders and touch a Bomb Flower beside them to blast open the Lost Woods shortcut.
steps.detail: The Bomb Flowers on either side of the boulders ignite from the flame of your stick. Step back after lighting one; the chain of explosions clears the tunnel. Not required, but it saves a lot of walking later.

steps.text: Stand in front of Darunia and play Saria's Song. After his dance he gives you the Goron's Bracelet.
steps.detail: The bracelet lets you pick up Bomb Flowers, which you need to open Dodongo's Cavern. If you never learned Saria's Song, take the new shortcut into the Lost Woods (left, left, forward, left, right to the Sacred Forest Meadow), learn it from Saria at the far end, and come back (left, right, forward, right, right).

steps.text: Climb to the second tier from the bottom, turn left, grab the Bomb Flower at the top of the next steps and throw it into the spinning urn so it explodes while the smiling face is toward you; a Piece of Heart pops out.
steps.detail: The urn must still be spinning (relight the bottom-floor torches if it stopped). The timing takes a few tries; the Bomb Flower regrows, so keep throwing. The heart piece appears at the base of the urn.

steps.text: Leave Goron City through the top exit, back onto Death Mountain Trail.
From the Goron City entrance, go right along the ledge to the overhang where a lone Goron sits next to a Bomb Flower.
Pick up the Bomb Flower and throw it straight over the ledge so it lands beside the boulder below, blowing open the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern.
steps.detail: Aim straight ahead from the edge. If it misses, wait for the Bomb Flower to regrow and try again. Then walk back down to the trail.

steps.text: Drop your bottled bugs on the soft soil patch just outside Dodongo's Cavern, kill the Gold Skulltula that crawls out and grab its token.
steps.detail: The soft soil is the round dirt patch next to the cavern entrance. If you have no bugs, get them from under the rock by the Graveyard entrance in Kakariko Village.

steps.text: Enter Dodongo's Cavern, pick up one of the Bomb Flowers by the entrance and blow up the cracked wall straight ahead to open the main cavern. Equip the Hylian Shield.
steps.detail: Fire enemies burn the Deku Shield; keep the Hylian Shield on for the whole dungeon.

steps.text: In the main room, reach the raised area on the left side, use its lone Bomb Flower on the cracked wall there and open the big chest for the Dungeon Map.
steps.detail: Either hop onto the middle platform (stay out of the Beamos statue's gaze) and then left, or follow the strip of dry ground along the lava at the left edge, round the back and climb the ladder. The other cracked wall here only hides a Business Scrub selling Deku Shields.

steps.text: Cross to the raised area on the right side of the main room, pick up its Bomb Flower and throw it at the Beamos on that platform to destroy it.
steps.detail: The first cracked wall on this side only hides a Gossip Stone, which you cannot use yet. The Bomb Flower regrows after each throw.

steps.text: Use the regrown Bomb Flower to blow open the cracked wall behind where the Beamos stood, and go through the passage.
Fight through the Baby Dodongos in the winding corridor and climb the ledge at the end to reach the barred door with a floor switch.
steps.detail: Slash a Baby Dodongo as it nears you, then step away: it explodes after dying. Halfway along, a cracked wall on the right hides a Gold Skulltula; you come back for it once you have Bombs.

steps.text: Push or pull one of the two Armos statues onto the floor switch to hold the barred door open, then go through.
steps.detail: These statues are inert. Grab one from the side facing the switch and push it straight on.

steps.text: Pass the short corridor with two Keese and enter the next room.
In the lower Lizalfos room, defeat both Lizalfos to unlock the doors, then continue through the far door.
steps.detail: They attack one at a time. Z-target the active one, keep your shield up and slash between its attacks; when it jumps over you, just hold the shield. Stay off the lava. The pots by the door hold hearts.

steps.text: In the long Dodongo room, kill the three Dodongos by hitting their tails.
steps.detail: Stand in front of one until it starts its fire breath, circle behind and hit its tail, then back off before it spins. Slingshot shots between attacks also work. The cracked wall in the corner near the entrance only hides a Business Scrub selling Deku Sticks.

steps.text: Light a Deku Stick on the one lit torch in the Dodongo room and light the three unlit torches to open the barred door, then go through.
steps.detail: Grab the flame near the start of the room and light the torches on the way to the far door.

steps.text: Back in the main room on an upper ledge, step on the floor switch to open the barred door across the room, then drop down and cross to it.
steps.detail: The opened door is on the lower level on the far side; go around the lava the way you came.

steps.text: In the giant staircase room, use one of the Bomb Flowers to blow open the cracked wall on the left, revealing a door, and go through.
In the Compass room, wake and defeat the Armos, then open the big chest for the Compass.
steps.detail: Touch the statue to wake it and back off. Stun it with a Deku Nut and jump-attack it; it explodes when it dies, so hold the Hylian Shield up or run. Return to the staircase room afterward.

steps.text: Pick up the lone Bomb Flower near the Compass room door and set it in the gap in the row of Bomb Flowers along the big pillar; the chain explosion sinks the pillar into a giant staircase.
steps.detail: Stand well back once it is placed.

steps.text: Climb the giant stairs and walk around to the vines on the south wall; shoot the Skullwalltulas and the Gold Skulltula there with the Slingshot, then climb up for the token.
steps.detail: The Gold Skulltula sits on the vines at the back (south) of the room. Kill it from below with the Slingshot before climbing so it cannot knock you off.

steps.text: Go through the door at the top of the staircase room into the hexagonal Armos room and shoot the Fire Keese with the Slingshot.
steps.detail: Fire Keese set a Deku Shield alight; keep the Hylian Shield equipped.

steps.text: Find the side of the central platform with the ladder, pull the inert Armos statue away from it, climb up and step on the switch to open the doors. Drop down and take the door the switch points you toward.
steps.detail: The living Armos statues do not need to be touched; only the one blocking the ladder moves.

steps.text: Back in the main room on the second floor above the entrance, cross the bridge to the far side, jumping the gap in the middle, and enter the next room.
steps.detail: Two Fire Keese patrol here; shoot them before jumping the gap so they cannot knock you off.

steps.text: In the Blade Trap room, jump straight down between the two pillars and go straight ahead, watching for the sliding traps, until you reach the stone block.
steps.detail: Blade Traps rush along fixed lines and return; wait for one to slide back before crossing its path. Use Z-targeting to peek around corners. A Recovery Heart sits in the hole behind the block.

steps.text: Pull the stone block over to the platform, climb up and open the small chest for a Red Rupee.
Pick up the Bomb Flower on the platform and throw it at the cracked wall above the ladder, then jump over and continue.
steps.detail: The Bomb Flower regrows if you miss. If landing it on the small ledge is hard, hold it until it flashes quickly and throw so it bursts in mid-air by the wall.

steps.text: Shoot the Eye Switch above the burning platform with the Slingshot to douse the flames, jump across and go down the hallway of Baby Dodongos to the door at the end.
steps.detail: The flames return after a moment; jump as soon as they vanish. Keep the shield up in the hallway and the Baby Dodongos hop over you.

steps.text: In the upper Lizalfos room, defeat both Lizalfos on the small platforms to open the next door, then go through.
steps.detail: Same tactics as before, but watch your footing over the lava. Recovery Hearts are on the side platform if you need them.

steps.text: Shoot the Eye Switch to put out the first flame, jump to the first platform, then shoot the second Eye Switch in the alcove to the left to put out the second flame and cross.
Back in the upper part of the Blade Trap room, jump to the next platform, climb the ledge on your right and open the big chest for the Bombs.
steps.detail: You get a Bomb Bag holding 20 Bombs. Ignore the cracked wall one level down; it hides two Business Scrubs selling Deku Nuts and Deku Seeds.

steps.text: Continue into the last part of the main room's second floor and step on the floor switch to raise the lift, creating a shortcut up to this floor.
Read the stone tablet by the switch, then head right onto the bridge above the giant Dodongo skull.
steps.detail: The poem says to light the skull's eyes red. Optional: bomb the cracked wall along the way for a small chest with a Red Rupee.

steps.text: Stand at each of the two holes in the bridge and drop a Bomb down (press the Bomb button twice) so it explodes on the eye below; once both eyes glow red the skull's jaw drops, revealing a door.
steps.detail: Do one eye, wait for the blast, then the other. The eyes stay lit.

steps.text: Get down to the main floor: drop from the bridge onto the top of the skull, then onto the platform below.
steps.detail: Or take the lift or the long way around if you prefer.

steps.text: Facing the skull, go through the farthest doorway on the right side back into the Baby Dodongo corridor, follow the right wall to the cracked wall and bomb it open.
In the small room behind it, kill the three Keese and the Gold Skulltula, then jump-attack or backflip up to grab its token.
steps.detail: A Bomb tossed at the group takes them all out. The token sits high on the wall; a jump attack or a backflip beneath it snags it.

steps.text: Return to the main room and walk into the open mouth of the Dodongo skull.
In the square room beyond, hop down, kill the Fire Keese if they bother you, then climb up on the right side and follow the long hallway.
steps.detail: The boss door here is barred for now; the block that opens it is found by looping through the next rooms.

steps.text: In the S-shaped room, shoot the two Fire Keese, drop down and work your way to the far side, climbing over the stone blocks in the way.
Bomb the cracked wall on the ledge at the far end of the S-shaped room and go through the door.
steps.detail: Throw the Bomb up onto the ledge, or hold it until it flashes fast and throw so it explodes against the wall.

steps.text: Defeat the Armos in the small room and grab the Gold Skulltula token it was guarding, then return to the S-shaped room.
steps.detail: Deku Nut, jump attack, then shield or run from the explosion. The Gold Skulltula is behind where the statue stood.

steps.text: Use the stone blocks to climb onto the high wall in the S-shaped room, run along its top and drop into the next area, then continue down the hallway.
steps.detail: The Fire Keese respawn; shoot them again if needed. A jar on the left of the drop-down area holds a Fairy you can bottle.

steps.text: On the upper ledge of the square room, push the stone block off the edge, then drop down and kill the two Fire Keese.
Push the stone block onto the switch in the hole in the center of the square room to hold the boss door open.
Go through the boss door, bomb the cracked patch on the floor and open the chest for Bombs, then drop through the hole to face the boss.
steps.detail: Top up so you enter with a full bag.

steps.text: Defeat King Dodongo.
steps.detail: When he opens his mouth to inhale before breathing fire, throw a Bomb (or a Bomb Flower from the edge of the arena) into it; he swallows it, is stunned, and you slash him. He then rolls around the arena: stand in an inside corner or near the lava edge, or hold your shield. Repeat four or five times. A jump attack as he lands after the stun deals extra damage.

steps.text: Take the Heart Container and step into the blue light to leave Dodongo's Cavern.
Watch the scene outside: Darunia names you Sworn Brothers and gives you the Goron's Ruby, the second Spiritual Stone.
steps.detail: He tells you to visit the Great Fairy at the top of the mountain, which comes after some cleanup. Step aside from the two Gorons who drop in for a hug.

steps.text: Head down the trail toward Kakariko Village, bomb the cracked wall where you hear a Gold Skulltula, shoot the Skulltula and climb the wall behind it for the token.
steps.detail: The cracked wall is on the side of the trail between Dodongo's Cavern and the Kakariko gate. Kill the spider with the Slingshot first, then climb the stone face to reach the token.

steps.text: Go back up the trail toward Goron City and bomb the second cracked wall on the way; open the chest behind it for a Purple Rupee.
In Goron City, wait for the rolling Hot Rodder Goron to enter the enclosed tunnel section on the north side and stop him there with a Bomb; he rewards you with a bigger Bomb Bag.
steps.detail: He rolls laps around one tier and runs you over if you stand in his path. Drop the Bomb just ahead of him inside the covered stretch so it bursts as he passes. If he stops anywhere else he just grumbles; try again on the next lap. Capacity goes up to 30 Bombs.

steps.text: Go to the top tier of Goron City and bomb the three boulders blocking the path on the west side.
steps.detail: You can also tightrope across the ropes to the pedestal, but bombing is faster.

steps.text: Follow the short path to the boulder maze and bomb through the normal boulders, keeping right for the first half and then the middle, opening the small chests for Purple Rupees along the way.
steps.detail: The silver boulders cannot be broken yet; leave them.

steps.text: Roll into the wooden crate at the back of the maze to free a Gold Skulltula, kill it and take its token. Then leave Goron City.
Back on the trail, return to where the path splits and take the branch climbing to the highest point; bomb the first boulder blocking the way.
Bomb the second boulder (hold the Bomb until it is about to explode, then throw it), jump over and pick up the Red Rupee that was under it.
Climb up and bomb the boulder there to uncover a hole with a cow inside; drop in and play Epona's Song for Lon Lon Milk if you want a refill.
steps.detail: Optional. The cow gives milk any time you play Epona's Song next to it with an empty bottle.

steps.text: Keep going up; when the volcano erupts, hold the Hylian Shield up and cross between bursts of falling rocks until it stops.
steps.detail: Hold R to block the debris and run during the gaps. It stops once you get close to the other side.

steps.text: Shoot the Skullwalltulas on the climbable wall with the Slingshot, then climb to the top of Death Mountain.
At the summit, ignore Kaepora Gaebora for now and enter the opening in the mountain on the right, into Death Mountain Crater.
Roll into the wooden crate right at the entrance of Death Mountain Crater, kill the Gold Skulltula inside and take its token.
steps.detail: The heat timer runs while you are inside; if it reaches zero you lose all your hearts, so watch it.

steps.text: Exit and re-enter to reset the heat timer, then run to the ledge, line up facing the Triforce platform below and run straight off the cliff; Link grabs the climbable wall.
Climb down the wall to the small alcove partway down and pick up the Piece of Heart there.
steps.detail: You cannot climb back up in time, so jump into the lava afterward: you lose one heart and reappear at the crater entrance.

steps.text: Leave Death Mountain Crater.
At the summit, place a Bomb against the cracked wall to open the Great Fairy Fountain and go in.
Stand on the Triforce symbol and play Zelda's Lullaby; the Great Fairy of Power gives you the Magic Meter and the spin attack.
steps.detail: Hold B to charge a spin attack; it uses magic. She also mentions her friend near Hyrule Castle, visited later this chapter.

steps.text: Outside, talk to Kaepora Gaebora, then stand beneath him when he finishes; he flies you down to a rooftop in Kakariko Village.
On the rooftop where the owl drops you, walk to the right edge above the Cucco pen and drop onto the thatched overhang below, then turn around and enter the hole in the wall of the house.
steps.detail: Do not jump off the main roof yet. If you do fall, play the Sun's Song before leaving the village to reappear on the roof, or ride the owl down again.

steps.text: Inside the house with the caged cow, pick up the Piece of Heart.
Go to the Market and enter the Bombchu Bowling Alley, on the same side as the Shooting Gallery, between the Hyrule Field exit and the road to Hyrule Castle.
steps.detail: Each game costs 30 Rupees; smash the pots in the guardhouse by the field exit for Rupees if you run low.

steps.text: Play Bombchu Bowling until you win the Piece of Heart.
steps.detail: First wall: line up perfectly straight and release when the path is clear. Second wall: angle about 45 degrees and let the Bombchu climb the side wall. Last wall: release when the big Cucco is off to one side. Prizes cycle in order: Bombchus, Piece of Heart, Bombs, Bomb Bag, Purple Rupee; the first prize is random, then they follow that order.

steps.text: Keep playing Bombchu Bowling until you win the Bomb Bag upgrade.
steps.detail: It raises your capacity to 40 Bombs. If you win the Purple Rupee first, the cycle wraps back to Bombchus, so keep going.

steps.text: Go to Hyrule Castle, climb the vines by the gate, go straight ahead, jump down and bomb the boulder behind the Dead End sign, then crawl through the hole.
steps.detail: Same vines you used to sneak in earlier; the boulder is in the corner where the sign stands.

steps.text: Stand on the Triforce symbol and play Zelda's Lullaby; the Great Fairy of Magic gives you Din's Fire.
steps.detail: Din's Fire lights every torch around you at once and burns nearby enemies; it costs magic. You need the Magic Meter from Death Mountain first.

steps.text: In the southwest of Hyrule Field, by the entrance to Lake Hylia, drop a Bomb in the exact middle of the four square fences to open a hidden grotto and drop in.
steps.detail: Stand centered between the four fenced squares. If you have the Stone of Agony, the controller rumbles on the spot.

steps.text: Talk to the Business Scrub in the grotto and pay 10 Rupees for the Piece of Heart.
Go through the Lost Woods to the last clearing before the Sacred Forest Meadow and bomb the boulder there to open a grotto.
steps.detail: From the Kokiri Forest entrance: right, left, right, left, straight, left, right reaches the meadow entrance; the boulder is in that final clearing. Or use the Goron City shortcut.

steps.text: Drop in and buy the Deku Nut upgrade from the first Business Scrub for 40 Rupees.
steps.detail: Your Deku Nut capacity rises to 30. The second scrub only sells regular goods.
steps.missable: Buy this before adult Link obtains the Poacher's Saw in the trading sequence; after that, this Business Scrub never offers the upgrade again.
